# hashChat

> A shared WhatsApp inbox for teams, with contacts, sales pipelines,
> broadcasts, automations and AI replies. Built by Buraq Tech in
> Lahore, Pakistan, for small and medium businesses that run on
> WhatsApp.

hashChat connects to a business's own WhatsApp Business number through
the WhatsApp Business API, so several people can work the same number
at once — something the standard WhatsApp Business app does not allow.

## What it does

- **Shared team inbox** — one WhatsApp number worked by the whole team,
  with read/assignment state visible to everyone.
- **Contacts** — custom fields, tags, CSV import, full conversation
  history per contact.
- **Sales pipelines** — deals moved through stages, with values.
- **Broadcasts** — bulk sends using WhatsApp templates approved by Meta,
  with delivery, read and reply tracking.
- **Automations** — keyword-triggered auto-replies.
- **Flows** — a no-code builder for multi-step question/answer
  sequences, with buttons and handover to a human.
- **AI replies** — answers drawn from the account's own knowledge base,
  handing over to the team when a conversation goes beyond it.
- **Android app** — with push notifications.
- **Public API** and an MCP server.

## Pricing

Prices are monthly, in Pakistani Rupees. Every plan starts with a
3-day free trial that does not require a card.

| Plan | Price | Team members | Contacts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | PKR 2,000 | 3 | 1,000 |
| Pro | PKR 3,500 | 10 | 10,000 |
| Business | PKR 7,000 | 25 | Unlimited |

Pro adds automations, flows, AI replies and API access. Business adds
unlimited contacts and priority support.

Payment is by bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa, confirmed by
uploading a receipt.

## Costs that are not ours

Meta charges per message sent, separately from hashChat's subscription.
In Pakistan the approximate rates are PKR 13 for a marketing message
(broadcasts, offers) and PKR 2.8 for a utility message (order updates,
reminders). Replying to a customer within 24 hours of their own message
is free, including automated replies, and Meta additionally allows a
number of free service conversations each month. Meta revises these
rates periodically, most recently in April 2026.

## Ownership

The WhatsApp number stays on the business's own WhatsApp Business
account; hashChat connects to it and the connection can be removed at
any time. Each account's data is isolated — no account can read
another's contacts or conversations. Contacts can be exported at any
time.

  rather than green since 2024:
  https://hashchat.uk/whatsapp-green-tick-verification-pakistan
